instruction: Candid action photograph, medium shot. Under an outdoor covered shelter, the boxer in the beige t-shirt and black sweatpants (R1) stands on the left, facing right in profile. He throws a punch with his boxing glove. On the right, the trainer in the green long-sleeve shirt and red shorts (R3) stands facing him, holding up a black focus mitt to block the punch. No bystanders are present in the background. Bright natural daylight illuminates the concrete floor and pillars, casting soft shadows.
